name: io.github.tonyyang0504/best_buy_ca-mcp
description: Best Buy Canada Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, mark_shipped. Every tool maps to

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BEST_BUY_CA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Shop API key generated in the Best Buy Canada (Mirakl) seller portal once the seller account is approved; sent verbatim as the Authorization header (no Bearer prefix).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BEST_BUY_CA_INSTANCE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host of Best Buy Canada's Mirakl marketplace without scheme, as shown in your Best Buy Canada seller portal (e.g. marketplace.bestbuy.ca); every call goes to https://<instance_host>/api/...

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_BEST_BUY_CA_SHOP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric shop id, only when your API key's user has access to several shops (sent as ?shop_id= on every call; the default shop is used otherwise).
